summary: Both edits carry all of the intent's content and place it sensibly. Both also add a concrete utility file path and say the weekly calendar places an interaction marker, which the intent does not state, and they repeat several requirements across entries.

findings.detail: The intent says only "the specified utility". Both notes resolve this to a concrete path, "(apps/web/modules/bookings/lib/bookingSheetKeyboardHandler.ts)", and fresh also lists it as the new node's file.

The calendar note says "Place the booking UID on calendar event buttons (and the weekly-calendar event interaction marker)". The intent puts only the booking UID on calendar event buttons. Its markers are something the sheet recognizes ("recognizing both interaction markers"), and it never says the calendar adds a marker.

The edge note repeats "connects the utility with a capture-phase keydown listener, removes the listener when it is no longer needed and keeps its navigation state current", which the booking-list-ui note already states.

The edge note "BookingDetailsSheet recognizes the weekly-calendar event interaction marker (alongside the list-row marker) so switching bookings through weekly-calendar events keeps the sheet open" repeats "Keep the sheet open ... by recognizing both interaction markers" from the sheet's modify note, and the calendar note says it again.
